g.text: They read your sentence at the church door and broke a clay bowl over the
threshold. Whatever you did — and the wieś argues about it still — the puszcza
is your country now. You have survived one winter in it already. That is one
The wieś is behind you the moment you stop looking at it. Somewhere between the
The village is quiet. The smith's fire is banked; the trader's door stands open.
